subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with details be hidden before mutating-tool handling, or should current visible-warning paths for mutating, cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose cases remain?
rationale: Current tests and mutation handling preserve visible exec failure details in several cases, while this PR asserts those warnings should always be suppressed; automation should not choose that product contract.

options.title: Clarify And Fix Before Merge
options.body: Decide the warning contract, then update the branch and regression tests so every exec-like detail path matches that contract.

options.title: Preserve Current Detail Paths
options.body: Reject or narrow this PR if visible exec warnings are still intended for mutating, cron, heartbeat, or full-verbose failures.

options.title: Adopt Suppress-All Policy
options.body: Accept that exec-like failures should be hidden even in detail contexts, but require the branch to move suppression before mutating handling and update the conflicting tests.

recommendation.title: Clarify And Fix Before Merge
recommendation.body: Decide the warning contract, then update the branch and regression tests so every exec-like detail path matches that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The policy decision crosses the shared tool-error helper and agent payload behavior where this history points to prior helper ownership.
